name: Challenge Coin
description: A gold tournament token. Grants entry to a gold-tier event.

name: Silver Challenge Coin
description: A silver tournament token. Grants entry to a silver-tier event.

name: Bronze Challenge Coin
description: A bronze tournament token. Grants entry to a bronze-tier event.

name: Red Key
description: A heavy iron key, warm to the touch. Dwarf-made.

name: Green Key
description: A small key carved from wood, smelling of pipe-weed.

name: Blue Key
description: A slender key of elven silver.

name: Black Key
description: A cold black key. It feels watched.

name: White Key
description: A white key bearing the sign of the Tree.

name: Strange Key
description: A key of strange make. Moon-letters run along its shaft.

name: First Shard
description: A shard of a broken seal, found in the deeps.

name: Second Shard
description: A shard of a broken seal, found in the deeps.

name: Third Shard
description: A shard of a broken seal, found in the deeps.

name: Fourth Shard
description: A shard of a broken seal, found in the deeps.

name: Fifth Shard
description: A shard of a broken seal, found in the deeps.

name: Colorless rune
description: Rune of the Hollow. Returns you to the Wizard's Hollow in the Shire.

name: White rune
description: Rune of the White Tree. Teleports you to Minas Tirith.

name: Black rune
description: Rune of the Corsairs. Teleports you to Umbar.

name: Blue rune
description: Rune of Imladris. Teleports you to Rivendell.

name: Red rune
description: Rune of Durin. Teleports you to Erebor.

name: Green rune
description: Rune of the Shire. Teleports you to Hobbiton.

name: White Staff
description: A healer's staff of the Houses of Healing. Restores half your life.

name: Black Staff
description: A staff of shadow. Hides you from the servants of the Enemy for a while.

name: Blue Staff
description: A staff of the Eagles. Lets you fly over the land for a while.

name: Red Staff
description: A staff of wizard's fire. Banishes the nearest enemy on the overworld.

name: Green Staff
description: A staff of Radagast. Doubles your speed for a while.

name: Manasight Amulet
description: A pendant with a small seeing-stone. Shows the colours of foes on the map.

name: Leather Boots
description: Sturdy boots for the long road.

name: Sandals
description: Light footwear. Most hobbits would rather go barefoot.

name: Aladdin's Ring
description: A ring of lesser make, wrought by elven-smiths in their apprenticeship.

name: Axt
description: A woodsman's axe, well balanced.

name: Basilisk Collar
description: A spiked collar from the kennels of Barad-dur.

name: Battle Standard
description: A tattered orc banner. Goblins rally to it.

name: Blood Vial
description: A vial of dark draught brewed in Dol Guldur.

name: Bronze Sword
description: An old bronze blade from the barrows of the Dunedain.

name: Dagger
description: A long knife of the Rangers.

name: Dark Amulet
description: An amulet of the Necromancer. It whispers at night.

name: Dark Armor
description: Black mail forged in the smithies of Mordor.

name: Dark Boots
description: Boots of a Morgul scout. Quick, but they chill the blood.

name: Dark Shield
description: A shield of bone and black iron from Minas Morgul.

name: Death Ring
description: A ring taken from a barrow-wight's hand.

name: Disrupting Scepter
description: A sceptre once borne by a steward of Arnor.

name: Dungeon Map
description: A map of old tunnels and secret doors.

name: Evil Ankh
description: A cursed charm of the Witch-king's realm.

name: Gold Armor
description: Gilded armour of the Tower Guard.

name: Gold Boots
description: Gilded greaves of the Citadel.

name: Gold Shield
description: A shield bearing the White Tree in gold.

name: Jandor's Ring
description: A dwarven ring of carved stone.

name: Lightbringers Boots
description: Boots of a herald of the West.

name: Mad Staff
description: A twisted staff of a fallen wizard.

name: Ring of Immortals
description: A ring of the Nine Rings' lesser kin. Do not wear it long.

name: Staff of the Demoncaller
description: A staff that calls up fire and shadow from the deep.

name: Steel Shield
description: A heavy round shield of the Rohirrim.

name: Treasure
description: A handful of dragon-gold.

name: Steel Armor
description: Good steel mail from Dale.

name: Life Amulet
description: A pendant blessed by the healers of Gondor.

name: Kite Shield
description: A kite shield of the Swan Knights of Dol Amroth.

name: Mirror Shield
description: A polished elven shield.

name: Heavy Arbalest
description: A dwarven crossbow from the Iron Hills.

name: Wood Bow
description: A simple bow of yew.

name: Heart-Piercer
description: A long bow of the Woodmen.

name: Unerring Sling
description: A hobbit's sling. Hobbits are deadly with stones.

name: Spell Book
description: A book of lore from the archives of Minas Tirith.

name: Traveler's Amulet
description: A charm of the Grey Pilgrim's making.

name: Mithril Boots
description: Light boots with mithril-ringed soles.

name: Cursed Ring
description: A ring with a cruel goblin-curse on it.

name: Snack
description: A hobbit-sized packed lunch.

name: Charm
description: A lucky token from the Green Dragon inn.

name: Change
description: A purse of silver pennies.

name: Fortune Coin
description: A lucky coin of the Master of Lake-town.

name: Robes of Omniscience
description: Robes of an Istar. Much is seen, little is borne.

name: Sting
description: Bilbo's elven blade. It glows blue when orcs are near.

name: Mithril Coat
description: Dwarf-mail, light as a feather and hard as dragon-scales.

name: Elven Cloak
description: A grey cloak of Lorien. The wearer is hard to see in wood or on stone.

name: Lembas
description: Elvish waybread. One bite keeps a traveller on his feet all day.

name: Phial of Galadriel
description: The light of Earendil's star. A light in dark places.

name: Anduril
description: Narsil reforged, the Flame of the West. The dead answer to its bearer.

name: Horn of Gondor
description: The great horn of Boromir. Its call brings aid from far away.

name: Dwarven Axe
description: A broad-bladed axe of Erebor. Baruk Khazad!

name: Ent-draught
description: A draught from Treebeard's stone jars. You feel taller and stronger.

name: Palantir
description: A seeing-stone of Numenor. You see far, but the Eye looks back.

name: The One Ring
description: Cursed. Its burden grows with every use, and the Nine hunt its bearer.

name: Glamdring
description: The Foe-hammer of Gondolin, Gandalf's sword.

name: Orcrist
description: The Goblin-cleaver, Thorin's sword from the trolls' hoard.

name: Barrow-blade
description: A blade of Westernesse, wound with spells against the Witch-king.

name: Bow of the Galadhrim
description: A long bow of the elves of Lorien, strung with elf-hair.

name: The Arkenstone
description: The Heart of the Mountain. Its holder grows sick with greed.

name: Thror's Map
description: Thror's map of the Lonely Mountain, with moon-letters on it.

name: The Black Arrow
description: An heirloom arrow of the line of Girion. It has never failed Bard.

name: Elfstone
description: A green stone set in a silver eagle. Hope of the Dunedain.

name: Evenstar
description: Arwen's jewel, a token of a choice made out of love.

name: Longbottom Leaf
description: The finest pipe-weed in the Southfarthing. Starts the battle with a Food.

name: Frying Pan
description: Sam's frying pan. Surprisingly good against trolls and orcs alike.

name: Hobbit Feet
description: Leathery soles and thick curly hair. No boots needed.

name: Ranger Boots
description: Worn boots of a Ranger of the North. They know every hidden path.

name: Ranger Blade
description: A plain sword of the Dunedain.

name: Rohirrim Shield
description: A green shield with the white horse of the Mark.

name: Wizard Staff
description: A gnarled staff in the Istari's manner.
